prompt_prefix: Full-body 2D beat-em-up game sprite, modern hand-painted retro pixel art, fine pixels, crisp readable face, consistent identity and costume, three-quarter side view facing right, transparent background, entire body and feet visible, no text, no props unless specified.
identity_rule: Use the approved portrait and model sheet as immutable references for every action.
camera_rule: Same camera, scale, lighting, palette, costume, proportions and facing direction in all 88 frames.

retry_policy.attempt_1: Generate against locked references and formula.
retry_policy.attempt_2: Retry only failed action with the QA defect named explicitly.
retry_policy.attempt_3: Final retry; reject the action and request manual art correction if it still fails.
retry_policy.never_retry: Approved portrait/model sheet or already approved actions must not be regenerated.
